text: The export button throws a 500 error every time I select more than two months of data. I lost an hour of work rebuilding the report.
Export is completely broken for us. Error screen, nothing downloads, three people on my team have tried.
Tried to download the quarterly report as XLSX and got a red error banner. Happens on both Chrome and Safari.
Report download fails silently now. The spinner runs forever and no file ever appears in my downloads folder.
Cannot export anything since Tuesday. This is blocking our month-end close and I need it fixed today.
Dashboard takes about 25 seconds to load every morning. It used to be instant.
Everything got slow after the last update. Charts time out constantly and I have to refresh twice.
Load times on the main dashboard have roughly tripled in the last month. Still usable, just painful.
Why does the overview page take so long to render? Twenty seconds of a grey screen before anything shows up.
Our analysts are losing ten minutes a day waiting for dashboards to paint. Please look at the query performance.
App crashed twice today while uploading a CSV and the data never arrived in the workspace.
CSV import dies partway through on any file over about 10MB. No error message, the tab just reloads.
Uploaded our customer file three times. Each time it says processing and then the records are simply not there.
The importer silently drops rows. We uploaded 4000 and 3100 landed, with no warning about the rest.
I cannot find where to change my billing email. Spent ten minutes clicking around settings before giving up.
Where do you update the card on file? It is not under Account and it is not under Workspace. Very confusing.
Billing settings are buried three menus deep. Had to search your help centre to find the page.
Took me ages to locate the invoice history. Not obvious that it lives under the org switcher.
Any chance of a Salesforce integration? We are copying records across by hand twice a week.
A native Salesforce sync would save our ops team a full day a month. Is one on the roadmap?
Please add CRM connectors, specifically Salesforce. Right now we export and re-import which is fragile.
We evaluated a competitor mainly because they sync with Salesforce out of the box and you do not.
Pricing jumped at renewal with no warning and nobody could explain the new tier to me.
Our renewal quote was 40% higher than last year. We were not told this was coming.
The per-seat cost has become hard to justify internally now that the price went up again.
Got an invoice at the new rate without any notice period. That is not how we expected this to work.
Support took four days to reply to a ticket I marked urgent. That is not acceptable at our plan level.
Still waiting on a response from last Thursday. Any update at all would be appreciated.
Three days for a first reply, and then the agent asked me to re-send information already in the ticket.
Your SLA says four hours. My last two tickets took over two days each.
The documentation for the webhooks API is missing the retry behaviour entirely.
Webhook docs do not say what the signature header is called or how to verify it. Had to guess from a blog post.
No example payloads in the webhook reference. Every other API I use ships those.
Could the webhook page document the timeout and backoff? We built the wrong assumption and lost events.
Love the new reporting view, genuinely saves me time every week.
The redesigned charts are excellent. Much easier to read in our Monday meeting.
Just want to say the new report builder is a huge improvement. Thank you.
Our team adopted the reporting module in a week with no training. That says something.
Best reporting experience we have used. Keep going in this direction.
SSO login has been failing since this morning. Our whole team is locked out of the product.
Okta sign-in returns an invalid assertion error. Nothing changed on our side.
SAML redirect loops forever and never lands in the app. Twelve users affected.
Cannot log in via our identity provider. The fallback password route works, which is a security problem for us.
On my phone the chart legend overlaps the data and I cannot read either one.
The mobile layout is unusable in portrait. Tables run off the side of the screen with no scroll.
Tried to check a dashboard from my phone during a call and half the controls were off screen.
Can we get reports emailed on a schedule? Right now someone has to log in and send them manually every Monday.
Scheduled delivery of saved reports would remove a recurring chore for our finance team.
Please add recurring report emails. Weekly and monthly cadence would cover almost all our use cases.
Is there a way to automate sending a dashboard snapshot every Friday? Cannot find one if there is.
